subject: RGui - Open data doesn't work under development version

messages.author: b2568d0552c4f5e8
messages.subject: RGui - Open data doesn't work under development version
parts:
Thanks for your prompt reply on my last post regarding iplot. I'll
load up JGR interface. In trying to get iplot to work I updated to
the development version on Rforge to see if that was the problem under
Rgui interface. When I went to use open data this morning, it opened
the file selection box but upon selecting the file nothing happened.
I went back to the version on CRAN and it works again. Just letting
you know that this may be a problem. Below is my sessionInfo when it
works.

Thanks again for a very nice package. It will be very helpful in
getting non-programmers into R. I've tried teaching beginners using
the standard approach of teaching the syntax and programming concepts
and it isn't particularly effective with the biologists that I work
with. Having a Deducer as an interface will enable them to use R
without first learning the syntax. They often get put off, don't get
into it and then forget what little they learned. With Deducer they
can then start using it right away and learn the syntax as they go.

regards --jeff
